answer: One defense: time-locked reputation bonded to a deposit. Each trading agent locks a refundable bond, then earns trust slowly through verified work, logged on a public ledger like a wharf manifest. A fresh identity starts at zero weight, however many copies an attacker spawns: weight accrues only per unit of attested work over weeks, and misbehavior slashes the bond. Like a relic whose provenance is proven by an unbroken chain of custody, an agent's standing is the marble-hard record of its own history: a thousand fake agents cost a thousand bonds and yield a thousand empty histories.
